input_file.description: Path to the input OpenStreetMap XML file.

output_file.description: Path to the output Garmin IMG file.

style_dir.description: Directory containing the map style definitions.

map_description.description: Description string displayed on the Garmin device.

manufacturer_id.description: Garmin manufacturer ID. 01 is standard for OSM tools.

product_id.description: Garmin product ID. Must be unique per map.

map_areas.description: List of map areas or regions to process. If empty, the whole input is processed as one map.
